_comment: Copy to config/brand.json and edit. The real file is gitignored: it is
your event's identity, not this project's, and it must not end up in a
fork's history. Everything here is optional - delete any key and the
neutral default in app/brand.py applies.
The values below ARE the neutral default theme, written out so you can
see the whole shape at once. Copying this file unchanged is a no-op.
Images are not configured here. Drop them into brand/ under these exact
names and they are picked up and served automatically:
brand/mark.png                   the square mark, in both page headers
brand/wordmark-en.png            the Latin wordmark, on the title card
brand/wordmark-ar.png            the Arabic wordmark, beside it
brand/favicon-32.png             the browser tab
brand/apple-touch-icon-180.png   a phone home screen
Any slot you leave empty is hidden rather than drawn broken. With no
wordmark artwork at all, the title card sets event_name in type instead.
After adding or replacing wordmark artwork, run:
uv run --with pillow python tools/brand_assets.py
which measures the files and writes web/brand-sizes.css, so the title
card is sized from your artwork rather than from a number in the
stylesheet. It is optional - without it the layout uses sane defaults.
